svg.title: Distance turns logistics into autonomy requirements
svg.desc: Original conceptual map; no mission schedule or communication-delay value is encoded.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(96%,95%,93%); fill-rule: evenodd;

circle.style: stroke: rgb(7%,49%,50%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(86%,90%,92%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(72%,42%,27%); fill-rule: evenodd;

polygon.style: stroke: rgb(7%,49%,50%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(7%,49%,50%); fill-rule: evenodd;

path.style: stroke: rgb(72%,42%,27%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 4, 3;

polygon.style: stroke: rgb(72%,42%,27%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(72%,42%,27%); fill-rule: evenodd;

path.style: stroke: rgb(72%,42%,27%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 4, 3;

polygon.style: stroke: rgb(72%,42%,27%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(72%,42%,27%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Local operating decisions need bounded autonomy, inventories, fault recovery and evidence.
Atmospheric oxygen production is one capability, not a whole industrial network.
